Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)
Enhances: Berserk
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Berserk Operating System. Berserk can be activated as half of a ROF 2 Action and lasts 15 seconds (5 Rounds). Non-FBC users without a Cyberspine take -4 on all Ranged Attacks while it is active. While active, the user's limbs count as Cyberlimbs for damaging Steel Cover and for Falling if they didn't already, but not for any other Cyberware Option or Enhancement; Berserk cancels the automatic Critical Injury effect of Mortally Wounded; and incoming damage is reduced by 2 before armor. The user also adds +1 damage before armor for each point of BODY above 10 to their first successful Brawling, Martial Arts, or Melee Weapon attack each Round. Once the duration ends it can't be activated again for an hour unless the user takes 3 Humanity Loss per consecutive activation inside that hour.

Foundry notes:

  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Berserk Operating Systems).
